last_result.headline: Named repo does not exist (404) - blocker recorded; audited mycarta/rogii-geosteering-toolkit (MIT) against the same intent. Their line is behind ours (OOF ~10.5 / LB ~12 vs our 8.8626 / 7.891 / 6.563). Their within-well TVT-Z decoupling (lateral-only slope +0.057, NOT -1) independently explains two of our own same-day negatives: M4 geometry-only (107.49 vs flat 15.91) and N1 centring (15.636 vs 12.518). Three independent confirmations of our closed lines; three formulations queued (n8/n7/n9).
